liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **High Time** (2 reviews): Garcia went right for it head first on this song; High Time hadn't been played in about 15 months [27][28]
- **Revolution** (2 reviews): Revolution was the last time played; Final Revolution from this show [28][35]
- **Deal** (1 review): Vocals at the end of Deal are sick, never heard before [32]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Foolish Heart is of the charts [29]
- **The Weight** (1 review): The Weight was the first performance ever [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-28.nak300.mandel.91202.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 145 min [1]
- **gd1990-03-28.aud.andrewf.87701.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 21 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Level adjustments and minor vocals distortion during Cold Rain & Snow [2]
- **gd1990-03-28.Senn441.Fitzy.Keo.126838.Flac1644**: audience recording; 20 songs; 145 min [3]
- **gd1990-03-28.158167.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 150 min [6]
- **gd90-03-28.sbd.gorinsky.8510.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 4.46/5 by 25 [17]. Said about its sound: Good recording quality, though some hiss is present; No matrix or 24-track SBD source from this tour rated less than 5 [27][30]

## Around the show

- Brent leaned back, microphone didn't catch the end of a word [31]
- Brent says Fuck Everyone on the final verse of The Weight [32]
- Crowd reaction to the first Weight performance is insanity [35]
- Crowd reaction to the weight is killer [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-28.nak300.mandel.91202.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Brian Mandel; transferred by Brian Mandel; source: Nakamichi 300 Shotguns CP4's & Sony TCD5M [1]
- **gd1990-03-28.aud.andrewf.87701.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: AUD (Changed mics between sets). Set One: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotguns. Set Two: Sennheiser MD-441's. Mics > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX 90/100 tape, with… [2]. Also: Plugged deck into unused 441s during intermission [2]
- **gd1990-03-28.Senn441.Fitzy.Keo.126838.Flac1644**: taped by Fitzy; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Fitzy, Transfer By Keo; Sennheiser 441s > Sony TC-D5M, Tapes Maxell MX-90s; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6… [3]. Also: Recorded by Fitzy, shared from his collection of masters [3]
- **gd1990-03-28.158167.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 30, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [6]. Also: Patch source recorded by John Cutler, supplied by Steve Marcus [6]
- **gd90-03-28.sbd.gorinsky.8510.sbeok.shnf**: source: 24 track SBD MR>Healy 2 track Mixdown>C>DAT>CDR>WAV>SHN [17]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-28 Nassau Coliseum, Uniondale, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-28-nassau-coliseum-uniondale-ny-usa/) [39]
